summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), introduced by Anthropic, has become the de facto standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and APIs through a uniform interface. By 2026 the ecosystem has matured into three layers—aggregator platforms that bundle hundreds of integrations, gateways/proxies that secure and route MCP traffic, and individual servers that expose a single service—with remote OAuth-secured hosted endpoints now the default deployment model. This matters because MCP lets any AI assistant (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot) read resources and invoke tools without bespoke glue code, dramatically accelerating agentic workflows.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators expose many integrations behind one MCP endpoint, gateways/proxies sit in front of MCP servers to add auth, routing, and observability, and individual servers each connect an AI agent to a single tool or service.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search and automation
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; Team/Enterprise pricing from ~$4/user/mo
strengths: Massive install base across Cursor, Copilot, Claude
tools.best_for: Automating code review, repo management, and CI/CD from an AI agent

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, web navigation, scraping, and end-to-end testing
strengths: Backed by Microsoft and widely installed
tools.best_for: Giving AI agents the ability to browse, test, and interact with web apps

tools.name: Composio (Rube MCP)
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps including Gmail, Slack, Jira, Notion, Linear, GitHub via a single MCP endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans scale by usage/seats, roughly from ~$29/mo
strengths: Managed auth for hundreds of tools
Single endpoint unlocks the whole ecosystem
Strong Cursor and agent framework support
tools.best_for: Teams wanting one managed gateway to hundreds of SaaS integrations

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP / Remote MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers with OAuth, Workers, and edge deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans from $5/mo plus usage
strengths: Easy remote MCP deployment with OAuth
Global edge network and durable objects
tools.best_for: Deploying secure, scalable remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, auth, storage, and edge functions for querying and schema management
tools.best_for: Letting agents read/write project databases and backend resources

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspace content for reading and updating docs
tools.best_for: Agents that manage knowledge bases, notes, and project docs

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Figma designs, components, and dev mode data for design-to-code workflows
tools.best_for: Turning Figma designs into code via AI agents

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Registry and hosting of thousands of MCP servers with one-click install and discovery
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Payments, customers, invoices, subscriptions, and billing operations
tools.best_for: Agents handling payments, billing, and financial data

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: Directory of thousands of MCP servers and clients for discovery and comparison
tools.best_for: Browsing and comparing the full MCP server ecosystem

tools.name: Slack MCP Server (korotovsky)
tools.connects_to: Slack channels, messages, and workspace data for reading and posting
strengths: Most widely adopted Slack MCP (~1,800 stars)
tools.best_for: Agents that read and post to Slack for team communication

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Error monitoring, issues, traces, and performance data for debugging
strengths: Pulls error context directly into agents
tools.best_for: Agents that triage and debug production errors

tools.name: Linear MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Linear issues, projects, and cycles for planning and tracking
tools.best_for: Agents that manage sprints, issues, and roadmaps
